text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the February Stakes, the first race of Smart Falcon's victory declaration, she decides to compete in the Kawasaki Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That means running two races back-to-back, which she'll need tenacity to get through. She heads to the track with a "whirly-whoo" cheer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some fans start to imagine her finding success running internationally. Hearing this, Smart Falcon becomes even more resolute.
